Install cosign with 'brew install cosign' (macOS) then run 'cosign generate-key-pair' to create cosign.key and cosign.pub in your current directory

COSIGN_INSECURE_IGNORE_TLOG=true cosign sign --key cosign.key --allow-insecure-registry localhost:5001/dojo/api:1.0 — the COSIGN_INSECURE_IGNORE_TLOG flag skips Rekor transparency log (not needed for a local registry)
After signing, update the Kubernetes annotation: kubectl annotate deployment api dojo.docker/signed=true -n dojo-docker-signing
